_comment: The real-render CALIBRATION set of new semantic states: capture.mjs --only (calibration-set.mjs prints the list), calibrate.py (encode a subset with the production encoder settings), calibration-guards.py (measure it) and the /lab/coach-motion-v2/calibration page all read THIS file. Per scenario: a few representative entry-head phases of the source loop (on the edge's stride grid) instead of the whole grid, and the canonical one the lab plays. Not a production pack: nothing here is shipped.
